sources.title: Namecheap .com domain price 2026 - registration and renewal

keyLimits.en: First-year introductory price; renewal is significantly higher (see cautions).
Free WHOIS privacy protection (WhoisGuard) included on eligible TLDs.

note.en: Separate hosting plans exist alongside domain registration; pricing changed as of May 2026 per Namecheap's own knowledge base article title.

cautions.en: .com renewal is typically 30-50% higher than the first-year introductory price (roughly $14-19/year vs ~$9.58 first year).
ICANN adds a mandatory ~$0.20/year fee per domain on top of the listed price.

Exact current prices could not be verified directly on namecheap.com in this session (site blocked automated access); figures come from third-party pricing trackers and should be reverified before publishing.

capabilities.en: Domain registration and transfer across hundreds of TLDs, with free WHOIS privacy (WhoisGuard) on most.
Bundled services beyond domains: shared/VPS/dedicated hosting, free SSL certificates on some plans, and email hosting (Private Email).

limitations.en: No permanent free plan; every product (domain, hosting, email) is paid, with low first-year introductory pricing on domains that rises at renewal.
Support and account management primarily self-service via knowledge base and ticketing rather than phone-first support.

reason.en: Domain registration at near-cost pricing with no markup on renewal, plus DNS and security tooling.
European registrar and hosting provider with comparable domain/hosting bundle.
